fields.english:
The earth is patient, and will wait for you until you are ready because she knows in time all things erode and are reborn. It is the cycle of things. Mountains become deserts. Rivers become canyons. The earth is the most stubborn and wise of all the elements.

You must learn patience and stamina above all things. The earth calls for you now because she feels you are ready. Consider this your rebirth if you succeed. You will never be able to go back to ignorance afterwards.

Good, <name>. Your return here signifies that you are indeed prepared for the next step.

Of all the elements, earth represents the foundation of all things. It is your strength, your stamina, and your patience. The Earth Mother will protect you, but only if you show her proper respect. She is the basis for life, and by observing her laws, you will gain a greater wisdom. Never forget the secrets she shares with you.

I shall make your sapta for you now, and by accepting it, a new path will open before you.

A sapta is a drink created to bind our spirits to the elements. Fused with magic, the potion will allow the open minded to see the elements as no one has seen them before. Your spirit will forever be tied to the element the sapta was created for, and only a select few of our kind know the secrets of its creation.

The sapta is always imbibed in a holy place, and never anywhere else.

Seek out the shaman shrine to the east of here and drink of the sapta.
Find Kodo Rock and drink the Earth Sapta.

Ah... <name>... pleased is the earth to have you here.

Bound together in body and spirit, you will go forward knowing that the mountains are your strength; the plains, your patience; and the world itself your essence.

Standing before the earth humbly is all that is required of you for you to pass this rite. But the others are not as passive. They may be chaotic and often violent, but such is the nature of the elements. Dual natures opposing one another, you must come to learn these things intricately.

Take this rough quartz from me and bring it to Seer Ravenfeather as proof of our meeting. She will craft a totem for you, and this pebble will be the heart of it. As small as it may seem, you will come to find that size does not matter, and that even the smallest of things can outlast mountains.

Be patient, <name>. Remain strong. And seek wisdom. This is what earth asks of you. In the end, you shall become one with the earth--respect it as it shall respect you.
Bring the Rough Quartz to Seer Ravenfeather in Camp Narache.

Greetings, <name>. You would not return to me if you had not accomplished your task. May I be the first to welcome you fully to the first path of four that will forever rule your travels.

If you have the stone the earth gave to you, I will give you the totem it promised. If not, then I pity you. There is much pride to be had when you've fully dedicated yourself to the elements.

Splendid.

The totem I will craft for you is more than a symbol--it has abilities beyond that. One use of the totem is a focus for spells. Those spells are tied to the earth, and as you earn greater and greater wisdom, more of the earth's abilities will be made accessible to you. Trainers found throughout Kalimdor will know when you are ready for greater knowledge and will let you know as much when you visit them.

But for now, take this earth totem...

Aye, the time's come, young shaman. Ye've grown stout and sturdy, like the stone beneath our boots. Takin' up the shaman's path shows ye've got the wisdom o' the mountain, even before ye've proven yerself. Ye've the grit of stone to walk the earth's path.

But to earn its favor, ye must face it proper. South o' here, the Frostmane trolls live in a cave.

Bring me two of the necklaces they wear, crafted from the Iceclaw bears. Then we'll speak more of yer future.
Bring 2 Frostmane Bear Pendants to Teo Hammerstorm in Anvilmar.

Patience, lad, is the earth's finest virtue. It's seen mountains crumble and rivers carve valleys--slow and stubborn, like a true <race>. The earth calls to ye now, for trouble brews on the horizon. Return successful, and ye'll be one step closer to bein' whole.

Others may envy yer wisdom, but that's their burden to bear.

Well done, lad. Ye've proven yerself ready. Earth's the bedrock of all things. It'll shield ye, but only if ye show it proper respect. Even stone can shift if slighted. Learn its ways, and ye'll grow wiser than most. Never forget the secrets it shares. 

I'll craft ye a sapta now--accept it, and ye'll walk the true path.
